summary: Reviewed 3 files (project-detail-dialogues.js, index.html, project-detail-dialogues.test.ts). All 10 OWASP categories checked. 0 Critical, 0 High, 1 Medium, 1 Low. Security sign-off: PASS.

comments.note: Medium — A03 Injection (XSS) — project-detail-dialogues.js line ~29, function _dialogueInlineMarkdown: the primary code path calls marked.parseInline(text) on the raw, unescaped text string. marked v4+ does not sanitize HTML by default (the deprecated 'sanitize' option was removed); raw HTML in the input passes through verbatim. If a text block in a JSONL file contains LLM-generated HTML (e.g. from a prompt injection attack), it will be written to innerHTML unfiltered. The regex fallback path is correctly safe (calls escapeHtml first). Risk context: localhost-only developer tool; JSONL files are written by the local orchestrator (trusted source); no authentication or user-submitted data involved. Remediation: pre-escape the input before marked.parseInline — replace `return marked.parseInline(text)` with `return marked.parseInline(escapeHtml(text))`. This preserves all Markdown syntax characters (*/_/`) while neutralising any embedded raw HTML, making the primary path consistent with the fallback. Does not block approval — Medium severity.

Low — A03 (defence-in-depth) — utils.js escapeHtml (pre-existing): single-quote characters (') are not escaped. In the modified code all HTML attribute contexts use double-quote delimiters, so this omission creates no injection vector in the new or changed code. No impact; noted for completeness. Recommendation: consider adding .replace(/'/g, ''') to escapeHtml for future-proofing when the function is next modified.

A01/A05 — Server-side path traversal protection confirmed: handleGetChunkFile and handleGetDialogueFile both apply an allowlist regex (CHUNK_FILENAME_RE / DIALOGUE_FILENAME_RE) AND a resolve-then-prefix-check as defence-in-depth. assertSafeSlug and assertSafeSegment are called on slug and repo parameters. URL parameters are encodeURIComponent-encoded on the client. No path traversal vector found.

A03 — All other string escaping in the new rendering functions is correct: tool-call name, detailLines, argsJson, result.content, checklist item content, and subagent-heading label are all passed through escapeHtml(). The delegated click handler reads DOM attributes and passes them to the API via encodeURIComponent. No injection vector found in these paths.
